name: opencode-terminal-cli
description: OpenCode terminal launcher for VS Code: open the OpenCode CLI agent in the integrated terminal with one shortcut and insert @file references from the editor. A dependency-free alternative to the official sst-dev.opencode extension, which stopped working with OpenCode CLI v2. Works with CLI v1 and v2.

enumDescriptions: Type the @file reference into the terminal (works with any CLI version).
Start OpenCode with --port <free port> and append the reference through its HTTP API (OpenCode CLI v1 style).
opencode.integration.markdownDescription: How the `@file` reference reaches OpenCode. `typed` sends it as terminal input and works with any CLI version. `port` starts OpenCode with `--port <free port>` and appends the reference over HTTP (`POST /tui/append-prompt`), which is how the OpenCode CLI v1 integration worked and avoids waiting on `opencode.fileRefDelay`. The CLI v2 rejects `--port`, so keep the default `typed` unless you run v1.

opencode.command.markdownDescription: Command used to start OpenCode in the terminal. Change it if the `opencode` binary is not on `PATH` (for example an absolute path or a version-manager shim).

opencode.autoIncludeFile.markdownDescription: Automatically append an `@file` reference for the active editor when a **new** OpenCode terminal is opened.

enumDescriptions: Bring OpenCode back up only if it was running in this workspace when the window was closed.
Always start OpenCode when a window with a workspace folder opens, even if it was not running before.
Never start OpenCode automatically; use the button or the shortcut.
opencode.openOnStartup.markdownDescription: Whether OpenCode starts by itself when a VS Code window opens. `restore` (default) reopens it only in workspaces where it was left running, so the terminal comes back as a running agent instead of an idle shell. `always` starts it in every workspace. `never` leaves it to the button and the shortcut.

enumDescriptions: A group of its own in the editor area, beside the active editor (the official extension's placement).
The integrated terminal panel at the bottom of the window.
opencode.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where the OpenCode terminal opens. `editor` (default) gives it a group of its own beside the active editor. `panel` uses the integrated terminal panel.

opencode.continueLastSession.markdownDescription: Start OpenCode with `--continue`, resuming the most recent session of the current project. `--continue` is added only when the project already has a session: continuing a project with none would just start a fresh session, and OpenCode's TUI reports an error when asked to continue nothing. A project left without one is started plainly.

opencode.fileRefDelay.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds before the automatic `@file` reference is sent to a newly opened terminal. Increase it if your shell startup is slow and the reference is swallowed before OpenCode starts.
